rationale: Selected 8 core macroeconomic and financial stability indicators representing economic growth (Real GDP), price stability (Inflation HICP), labor market dynamics (Unemployment rate), fiscal health (Overall balance and General government gross debt), external sector balance (Current account balance), and banking sector soundness (NPL ratio for asset quality and CT1 ratio for capital adequacy).
